Key facts recorded before implementation:

- The e2e `webServer` builds with `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1`, so test-time
  `dist` carries the injected internal surface (`/curate/**`, `/releases/`,
  `/research-dossier/**`, `/visual-language/`, `/contribution-back/`); the
  publishable build does not. The registry must classify both builds.
- `dist/**/*.html` today = 49 routes with internal injection (incl. flat
  `403.html`/`410.html` copies `sigChrome` emits, `/terms/`, dossier
  `…/print/` pages, `/data-freshness/status/`).
- T2 pages today emit exactly two inline scripts, byte-identical across
  `/map/`, `/network/`, `/search/` — the Astro `astro:only` bootstrap and
  the `astro-island` custom-element runtime. They are the "hashed Astro
  bootstrap" the script policy allow-lists; the recorded sha256 hashes are
  held in `astro-runtime-script-hashes.json`. Anything else fails closed.
- D-J3-7's recorded answer (row 318) is **linked files only** — no inline
  `application/ld+json` block is permitted on any page type; JSON-LD is a
  linked file (`<link rel="alternate">`), which is not a script element.
- `sig.workspace-state/1` names the T2 state params (CONTRACT_PARAMS:
  release, collection, q, kind, jurisdiction, technology, source,
  location, focus, view, page); the no-JS stateful-URL notice names them.
- The root-absolute-path containment check (`check:paths`, P35.65) counts
  every `"/…"` literal in `web/src/**`; the registry's route patterns are
  classification data, exempted file+token+count in the baseline allowlist
  (the designed mechanism for non-link literals).

## Phase 2–4 — implementation + self-review (2026-10-22T10:19Z)

Landed:

- `web/src/lib/page-types.ts` (733 lines) — the registry: K0 §4.2's table
  verbatim extended only for built routes the table does not name
  (`/terms/`, `/data-collection/`, the flat `403.html`/`404.html`/`410.html`
  error copies) and for K0's own interim (`/network/` classified as the T2
  surface it currently is — its redirect/T1 migration is the GX-09a row's).
  Each entry carries patterns, type, owner ticket, contract id (or the
  recorded string `none` for copy-only surfaces — absence is recorded,
  never a fabricated id), the K0 §4.4 no-JS equivalent (kind +
  description + parity testIds on T2), `internal` for the injected
  surface, and per-entry `examples` the unit test classifies back to
  their own row. Matching is most-specific-wins with leaf-first coverage
  vectors (`/**/print/` beats `/dossier/**` on a print page; `/s/*/map/`
  stays T2 inside the `/s/*/**` T1 umbrella); a zero-match is
  `unclassified`, a two-entry tie is `ambiguous` — both build errors.
- `web/astro.config.mjs` — `sigPageTypes()` `astro:build:done` hook,
  last in the integration chain so it sees the complete emitted tree:
  walks `dist/**/*.html`, classifies every route, throws on any
  unclassifiable route, writes `dist/page-types.json`
  (`sig.page-types-manifest/1`: path, file, type, matched pattern, owner,
  contract, chrome, internal).
- `data-sig-chrome` markers added to `BaseLayout.astro` (`full`),
  `CurateLayout.astro` (`curate`), the dossier print layout (`print`) —
  the minimal-chrome pages already carried `minimal`.
- `web/src/components/NoJsStateNotice.astro` — the K0 §4.4 stateful-URL
  notice, mounted inside the island section of `/map/`, `/network/`,
  `/search/` with each surface's `sig.workspace-state/1` param names and
  anchor links to its named no-JS equivalents. Rendered inside
  `<noscript>` (a static build cannot condition markup on a query
  string — the notice is present on every no-JS load and its wording is
  conditional: it names what a URL on the page CAN encode); invisible
  whenever JS runs.
- `web/tests/e2e/astro-runtime-script-hashes.json` — the two recorded
  sha256 inline Astro bootstrap hashes (bootstrap + astro-island
  runtime), byte-identical across the three T2 pages today.
- `web/tests/e2e/t1-module-entries.json` — the T1 `type="module"`
  entry allow-list, `sig.t1-module-entries/1`, **empty by contract**
  (the mechanism is this row's; UXK0-4's elements register entries).
- `web/tests/e2e/script-policy.spec.ts` — the policy half of
  `islands.spec.ts`, same-or-stronger over the discovered routes: T0
  asserts no `<script` substring at all; T1 rejects anything that is
  neither an allow-listed module entry nor a recorded bootstrap hash;
  T2 requires scripts present and admits only recorded bootstrap
  hashes + `type="module"` `/_astro/` asset srcs; inline
  `application/ld+json` is a violation on every type (D-J3-7 = linked
  files only); `on*=` handlers and `javascript:` URLs banned on every
  discovered route (incl. T3).
- `web/tests/e2e/nojs-parity.spec.ts` — T1 `main` text JS-off ==
  JS-on minus `[data-enhancement]` (with a mechanism proof that only a
  `data-enhancement` difference is tolerated — an unmarked difference
  is caught); each T2 route's registry-named equivalent testIds
  resolve with JS off; a stateful `?v=1&focus=…` URL opened with JS
  off shows `no-js-state-notice` naming the static equivalents, and
  the notice is inert under JS.
- `web/tests/e2e/pages.ts` — rewritten to load
  `dist/page-types.json` and derive every sweep list
  (`SHELL_PAGES`/`ALL_PAGES` = chrome `full`, `CHROME_PAGES` =
  `minimal`, `CURATE_PAGES` = T3, `ISLAND_PAGES` = T2,
  `A11Y_PAGES` = every route, `FRESHNESS_SORT_PAGES`,
  `JURISDICTION_DOSSIER_PAGES` from type+path); named fixture anchors
  retained. Manifest missing/stale → loud error telling you to build.
- Rewired: `a11y.spec.ts` (axe over all 49 discovered routes),
  `shell.spec.ts`/`corrections-methodology.spec.ts` (via
  `SHELL_PAGES`), `chrome.spec.ts` (public surface = discovered
  non-internal minus flat error copies), `curate.spec.ts` +
  `curate.nojs.spec.ts` (via `CURATE_PAGES` — now covers the dynamic
  `[id]` curate routes too), `budget.spec.ts` (guards: every
  discovered T2 route carries an island-budgets row until P35.51).
- `islands.spec.ts` — policy describes removed (moved to
  script-policy); interactive island assertions untouched.
- Root `AGENTS.md` gotcha 6 + `web/AGENTS.md` gotcha 1 rewritten to
  the landed registry; the "until P35.50/P35.51 land" hedge retired.
- `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` entry (P35.50, row 328,
  R11-K13-UXK0-1, SIG-UI-036/037/041/050, ADR-155).
- `web/scripts/root-absolute-paths-baseline.json` — the registry's
  `"/…"` pattern/guard literals exempted via the designed allowlist
  mechanism (file+token+count+reason), never a baseline raise;
  containment still holds at 157 counted.

Discovered-route census (internal build, `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL=1`):
49 routes — T1 29, T0 9, T3 8, T2 3; chrome full 31, curate 8,
minimal 7, print 3. Default (publishable) build: 36 routes. The
discovered-vs-hand-list delta the contract asks this row to record:
the prior `SHELL_PAGES`/`A11Y_PAGES` hand list swept 28 routes; the
discovered sweep now covers all 49 — 21 routes previously unswept by

sweep their classification selects, and no new route can land outside
a sweep again.
